authority.rule: Same campaign id, world seed, location and campaign instant must produce exactly the same environment snapshot. Environment derivation may not write campaign state.

separation_invariants: Static terrain/location kind is not transient weather.
Derived weather does not own mutable fire, smoke, flood-control, siege, office-hours, gate, staffing, or institutional availability state.
A weather transition does not by itself create a player wake or scheduler event.
Player-safe context exposes current-location environment only unless another read lawfully authorizes a different location.
Mechanical consumers use only registered mechanical_effects channels; narration may not invent additional bonuses or penalties.
